en.content:
Use a simple “AI eye-drop warp” video workflow: (1) show yourself applying eye drops, (2) cut to you shouting “It’s here!”, (3) cut to the destination shot and say “Welcome to ○○” to sell the teleport effect.

2. Shout “It’s here!”
